decode_contract.input_embedding_service: resident lookup; capacity retained but excluded from full-array active-weight bytes per generated token
decode_contract.expert_service: exact configured 8/128 storage fraction per layer; equal expert shapes make byte count route-identity independent, but no temporal/router-locality credit is taken
decode_contract.fp8_gemm_semantics: checkpoint-declared FP8 E4M3 weights and dynamic FP8 activations; two tensor operations per selected matrix weight is a GEMM lower bound
decode_contract.bf16_gemm_semantics: BF16 router and LM-head matrices; two tensor operations per matrix weight is a GEMM lower bound
decode_contract.kv_traffic_semantics: logical full-attention K/V bytes from the published topology; not measured HBM traffic and excludes allocator, paging, reread, metadata, and kernel effects

claim_boundary: The profile inventories the exact locally pinned checkpoint tensor headers without claiming that the checkpoint was numerically qualified for OpenTallas.
The benchmark is text-only; the visual tower remains part of full endpoint capacity but is not active during the measured decode requests.
The matrix-operation count is a lower bound and excludes normalization, rotary embedding, softmax, routing selection, sampling, and other vector/control work.
The logical KV calculation is architecture-derived rather than a measured GPU HBM counter.
No router trace, target-ROM implementation, or OpenTallas performance is supplied by this profile.
